stories.text: 😱 INSTANT REGRET: The Mahomies would have beaten Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy by starting Ryan Flournoy (19.10 pts) over Omar Cooper Jr. (0.00 pts). Oops!
😱 INSTANT REGRET: Claremont In Yo Stace! needs 3.36 pts more to beat Ruffing the Passer. Starting Cam Skattebo over Devin Singletary would have locked it up.
👀 All eyes on Andrews (LAC @ BAL): if Andrews tops 3.36 pts, Claremont In Yo Stace! (72%) beats Ruffing the Passer. ESPN projects 6.91 pts.
📈 COMEBACK: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy was down to 7% against The Mahomies — and won.
🪦 The eulogy is in: Joe's Scary Team gets its send-off (14.72 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: the blade has fallen — Joe's Scary Team is getting chopped from Chop it like its Hot! with 207.29 pts.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Claremont In Yo Stace! vs Ruffing the Passer. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Claremont In Yo Stace! 84% / 56%, Ruffing the Passer 62% / 30%.
🧟 LINEUP ALERT: Ladd McConkey is listed OUT, and yet there he is in Kirbo Crushers' starting lineup. You have until Monday 8:15 PM.
🎯 TWO WINS: Ruffing the Passer: 67% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 30% with none (now 37%).
🎲 GUTSY CALL: Claremont In Yo Stace! started Singletary (NYG's RB2) over Skattebo. It backfired: Skattebo outscored Singletary by 26.90.
⚠️ ELIMINATION WATCH: Kirbo Crushers could be officially out of the race for a playoff spot as soon as next week.
👀 League gossip: Claremont In Yo Stace! may be wishing they trusted Cam Skattebo — 27.20 pts are sitting on the bench.
📈 Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy was down to 7% against The Mahomies — and won.
💓 49er Faith-Fool outlasted TDsMaGee after the favorite flipped 5 times.
